sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: Cameras side by side, as a watch room shows them: each feed in a tile of the video's shape with its name, its state, how many things the finder sees in it and a critical ring on one that calls for a look; the focused camera first and two tiles across, so one feed is watched closely with the rest in view.

anatomy.container: A grid of equal columns (parts' Columns, fill), as many as fit with no tile narrower than min, 8 apart, rows packed dense.
anatomy.tile: 16:9, on terminal, rounded by radius-surface, its picture clipped to it, in terminal-foreground. With alert: ringed 2 wide in critical. Focused: first in the grid, and two columns wide and two rows tall once the wall is 42rem wide.
anatomy.picture: The feed contained in the tile: the camera's src played muted and looping (playing on by default), its poster without one, or the app's picture. Offline: no picture, a camera-off icon 24 square in terminal-foreground at 50 percent in the middle.
anatomy.state: At the top start, 8 in: a chip on terminal/70, padded 6 across and 2 down, rounded by radius-mini, at text.2xs 500: a dot 6 across (live good; recording critical, breathing; offline faint; connecting a spinner 12 square in its place) then the state's word.
anatomy.detections: At the top end with more than none and not offline: a chip like the state's with an eye-scan icon 12 square and the count's phrase.
anatomy.enlarge: With onFocusChange on a tile that draws the app's picture: an icon button (extra small) at the top end on terminal/70 with an enlarge or shrink icon, named by enlarge.
anatomy.name: At the foot: the camera's name at text.xs 500, cut with an ellipsis, padded 8 across, 16 above and 6 below, on a fade from terminal/85 up to nothing.

cameras.does: Each camera: its id, name, state, and its src, poster or picture, with a detection count and alert.

onFocusChange.does: Makes each tile a button that takes it large, or puts the large one back.

playing.does: Whether the tiles' own videos play.

min.does: The narrowest a tile gets before a column goes: 7.5, 10, 14 or 18rem.

rest.means: Each camera's tile in its state.

hover.means: The pointer over a tile that is a button: washed in terminal-foreground at 5 percent.

focused.means: The camera taken large: first, two tiles across and two down where there is the room.

alert.means: A camera that calls for a look: ringed in critical.

focus.means: Keyboard focus on a tile's button: the focus ring inside its edge.

keyboard.does: Reaches each tile's button in turn when the wall has onFocusChange.
Takes the tile large, or puts the large one back.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
